name: io.github.digitalmentes7-maker/gobuy-product-trust
title: GoBuy Product Trust
description: Marketplace-evidence trust scores for AI agents: a 0-100 Evidence Score with signal breakdown for Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Best Buy listings; storefront trust scores for any domain. Reference evaluator for GPV-1, the open pre-purchase verification spec (docs.gobuy.ai/standard).

tools.name: check_product_trust
tools.description: Evidence Score (0-100) and signal breakdown for one marketplace listing

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Inspect and rank 2-20 listings by evidence quality

tools.name: analyze_reviews
tools.description: Per-review forensics: integrity score, adjusted rating, suspicious-review flags

tools.name: check_store_score
tools.description: Store trust score and agent-readiness tier (A-D) for any storefront domain
